answer: Reward vesting with clawback resists sybils: earnings vest linearly over many epochs instead of settling at once, and an identity caught cheating forfeits its entire unvested balance. A farm that mass-earns then exits finds the kernel of its rewards still locked, clawed back the instant detection lands inside the vesting window. A sybil must therefore stay clean the full vesting horizon to realize payouts — a hit-and-run becomes a prism of exposure, each epoch another audit draw. One honest agent waits out its ivory-steady vest. Precondition: vesting horizon exceeds expected time-to-detect.
